verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm whose client-facing product includes a secure online portal. A built-in AI assistant in such a portal is plausible, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only human service (a dedicated attorney and case manager) and a portal for document upload, messaging and status tracking, with no AI assistant that tasks can be delegated to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
